gauge.$description: Gauge: a value against its scale, as an arc, a circle or a bar.

size.$description: The width of an arc or a circle.

thickness.$description: How thick the track and the fill are.

range-width.$description: How thick the band of a range is, outside the track.

length.$description: The length of an upright straight gauge.

tick-length.$description: How long a tick of the scale is; a small tick is half as long.

tick-width.$description: How thick the ticks, and the outline of a callout, are.

marker-size.$description: The size of a marker or a mark: a triangle, a circle, a rhombus, the pointer of a callout.

spacing.$description: The room between the track, the ranges, the marks, the ticks and their values.

series-1.$description: Color 1 of the ranges that have neither a tone nor a color.

series-2.$description: Color 2 of the ranges that have neither a tone nor a color.

series-3.$description: Color 3 of the ranges that have neither a tone nor a color.

series-4.$description: Color 4 of the ranges that have neither a tone nor a color.

series-5.$description: Color 5 of the ranges that have neither a tone nor a color.

series-6.$description: Color 6 of the ranges that have neither a tone nor a color.

series-7.$description: Color 7 of the ranges that have neither a tone nor a color.

series-8.$description: Color 8 of the ranges that have neither a tone nor a color.

fill.$description: The fill, outside any range with a tone.

good.$description: The fill and band in a range whose tone is good: a chart status color, made to show on every background.

warning.$description: The fill and band in a range whose tone is warning: a chart status color, made to show on every background.

danger.$description: The fill and band in a range whose tone is danger: a chart status color, made to show on every background.

tick.$description: The ticks of the scale: `color` paints them.

mark.$description: A mark of another value: `color` paints it.

tip.$description: The value or the mark under the pointer.
